faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Pune Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IISER Pune Project Associate-I recruitment is 15th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MS or M.Sc degree in Earth Science, Geophysics, Applied Geophysics, Marine Geophysics, Applied Geology, Geology, or allied subjects to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be considered based on educational qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 37,000/- along with 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IISER Pune Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates will be notified if they are selected for the interview round.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate-I position announced by IISER Pune in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The position of Project Associate-I is offered on a contractual basis.
